periods.time: Invisible helicopter strike over the U.S. fleet
periods.label: 猎人之森隐形强袭

status.current: withdraws to support the coast after delivering Kurono and disabling carriers

relationships.kagami-kusakabe: Combines his invisible arrows with her multiplication to devastate ships.
relationships.shinguji-kurono: Helps deliver Kurono invisibly over the fleet, then follows her order to withdraw.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Still resents losing to Ikki and vows to defeat him someday.

periods.summary: Kirihara's Area Invisible has advanced enough to hide not only himself but also a helicopter, its sound, scent, and detection signatures. He uses this ability to insert Kurono over the U.S. fleet. With Kagami multiplying his Million Rain arrows, he silently cripples aircraft carriers and escorts before the Americans can locate them. He remains vain, bitter about Ikki, and risk-averse, but his improved ability becomes a key part of Itsuki's first counterstroke against the Pacific Fleet.

key_events.summary: Uses Area Invisible and Million Rain, amplified by Kagami, to disable U.S. ships and deliver Kurono.

abilities: complete sensory camouflage over external objects
